correctness.rationale: Exact elementary recurrence f(n)=1+(n+1)f(n−1)/(2n) yields f(N−1)=N/2^N sum_(j≤N) 2^j/j. The convergent 2-adic logarithm and Li_2 involution show Li_1(2)=Li_2(2)=0. Li_3(2) has a unique lowest valuation term h=4 of valuation −2. Subtracting the omitted tail and the exact four-term reciprocal identity gives −N³Li_3(2)+N⁴R_N; term valuations h−4v_2(h)≥−4 for h<N, and h≥N gives higher valuation, hence v_2(R_N)≥−4. For e≥4 the main and error valuations cannot cancel. Exact-rational independent sums through e=8 match harmonic transform and formula; only proof establishes all exponents.
